origin.summary: Workout 4 of the 2019 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A two-part workout: three rounds of snatches and bar-facing burpees, followed by three rounds of bar muscle-ups and bar-facing burpees.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2019/4 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
